failed_attempts.issue: execute() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ref_image_1' (flat autogrow slot name attempted directly, without the 'ref_images.' dotted path prefix required by build_nested_inputs)
RuntimeError: tensor a (3072) must match tensor b (128) at dim 2 — same deterministic VAEDecodeAudio shape-mismatch bug seen in LTX run 1
execute() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ref_image' (legacy singular key, not present in the live V3 Autogrow-based schema at all)
execute() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ref_image_0' (flat key, still missing the required 'ref_images.' dotted prefix)
execute() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ref_image' (previous agent's carried-over handoff state; legacy key + audio_vae + ref_image_size, still missing the dotted autogrow path)

root_cause: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.ref_images is an io.Autogrow.Input (prefix='ref_image_', min=0, max=9). ComfyUI's V3 dynamic-input machinery (comfy_api/latest/_io.py: parse_class_inputs / Autogrow._expand_schema_for_dynamic / build_nested_inputs) only recognizes an autogrow slot when the prompt JSON's flat input-dict key is the DOTTED path '<autogrow_field_id>.<slot_name>' (e.g. 'ref_images.ref_image_0') — not the bare slot name and not the legacy singular 'ref_image'. This exact convention is what the node's own frontend (custom_nodes/ComfyUI-ALLinONE-MinimaxH3/web/one_node_minimax_h3.js, wf['6'].inputs[`ref_images.ref_image_${idx}`]=[id,0]) already does; it was just never applied to the hand-built showcase R2V prompt JSON. audio_vae and ref_image_size are separate required/optional non-dynamic inputs that also had to be added — the production workflow predates both of these schema additions.
resolution: Built showcase/workflows/h3_r2v-showcase.json as a copy of production/workflows/h3_r2v.json with: (1) 'ref_image' replaced by 'ref_images.ref_image_0', (2) 'audio_vae': ['4', 0] added, (3) 'ref_image_size': 'match' added, (4) LoadImage pointed at bx77-anchor.png, (5) showcase prompt/filename_prefix substituted. production/workflows/h3_r2v.json was left completely unmodified — git diff confirms no changes to any file under production/.

correctness_gate.identity_preserved: yes — subject is a visibly gunmetal/brass armored robot knight matching the bx77 anchor's general silhouette and material language; single accepted take, no further iteration performed after success
